kind_note: unreleased internal model; in the coverage found, the one internal model identified is codenamed Model 2
note: The label is generic, so this record covers the internal model that the coverage identifies: Model 2, from Anthropic's Risk Report of August 2026. The-decoder (Aug 20, 2026) reports the Risk Report as saying "There are no plans to release the model externally right now." Other coverage (Axios, 14 Aug 2026; Unite.AI) says Model 2 is one of the internal models that have not been publicly released, and Anthropic says it trains many exploratory models it does not intend to release. No public release date exists for Model 2 in the sources found. The Axios article returned HTTP 403 and the Anthropic Risk Report itself was not opened, so the quote above is from secondary reporting, not the primary document. The searches turned up no later release news for Model 2 after August 2026, but coverage after that month is thin, so this is not a confirmed current status. Claude Opus 5 and other models that were once internal have since been released; they are different systems and are not counted here. If the intended system is one of those, the record should be redone under that model's name.
